source.text: The Thornwick Logistics Senior Facilities Agreement requires Total Net Debt to Adjusted EBITDA not to exceed 6.50:1 for Test Dates on or before 2026-12-31, 6.25:1 for Test Dates from 2027-03-31 through 2027-12-31, and 6.00:1 for Test Dates on or after 2028-03-31.
Thornwick Logistics Holdings Limited's 31 March 2026 compliance certificate had certified Total Net Leverage of 6.47x against a 6.50x limit.
The Thornwick compliance certificate was signed on 13 May 2026 by R. Sandoval, Chief Financial Officer.
Thornwick Logistics Holdings Limited's 31 March 2026 restatement removed £5.0m of EBITDA, mainly from a £3.0m disallowed synergy add-back and £1.7m of revenue recognised too early.

Thornwick Logistics Holdings Limited's Events of Default under Clause 22.4 at 31 December 2025 and 31 March 2026 were subsequently waived and the covenant levels were reset under Amendment & Waiver No. 1 dated 28 August 2026.
